## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run test:vitest`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint:boundary`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when public behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, authorization headers, SAS tokens, live storage URLs, generated output, or customer documents are included.
